children.value: > Fact From Story: Wang told the court about the advantages that Alameda received by having code baked into FTX's software that allowed special access to the crypto exchange.
> > Fact From Story: Those privileges ultimately resulted in Alameda owing FTX $8 billion worth of customer deposits.
> > > Fact From Story: "We gave special privileges on FTX that gave unlimited withdrawals on the platform to Alameda," Wang said.
> > > Fact From Story: Alameda was allowed to withdraw and transfer those funds and had a $65 billion line of credit.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Unlimited withdrawals can result in a large debt.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Privileges can result in debt.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Special access to a crypto exchange can include the ability to make withdrawals.
